bestBets.overview: Casterton was rated Soft 7 when acceptances were taken on Thursday. Fine weather through the weekend though so we could be poised for an upgrade or two. We get it going with a 1000m Maiden. 4, 7 and 10 were also in at Warracknabeal on Saturday. It looks as though 4 and 10 have chosen this race and KHADIRA will come out. MONEY HONEY was solid on debut now returns from a break after winning a mid August jumpout. We're being offered $1.40 on race morning so I'll be watching on. MAGNUM has had four jumpouts since late June and won the latest - a little 600m job over the back at Geelong - by leading. GETAWAY has had five overall, two recently. The latest was here on Heavy 10 on August 10th and he was basically a close 2nd of 5 throughout with Tom Madden on.

raceTips.comment:
